title: Bound managed Usage snapshot latency and payload
scope: Benchmark and reduce managed-local Usage snapshot latency and response size without weakening retained-history truth, privacy, or unknown-state semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Before Build, record representative retained-history benchmarks and approve an explicit latency and payload target.
Unchanged retained history is not fully rescanned or reserialized on every viewer refresh, while new observations remain visible and deterministic.
Focused performance checks, full verification, live managed-local measurement, and Independent QA pass at an exact revision.
